items.abstract_or_text: 🚀 Meet MiniCPM5-2B, a 2B-parameter language model bringing high intelligence density to the edge, now open source! It ranks #1 among open-source models under 4B parameters on the @ArtificialAnlys Intelligence Index, with a score of 23. It also scores 20 on the Agentic Index, bringing an early form of general-purpose agent capability to the edge. items.title: Unlocking Sensitive Data with SPHERE in the Age of AI
items.abstract_or_text: Sensitive human data underpin discoveries across medicine, biology and the social sciences, yet privacy regulation often prevents sharing them with collaborators or artificial intelligence (AI) systems. We introduce SPHERE, a model-free method that makes sensitive datasets directly usable by AI and shareable for open science as a synthetic twin, while the original records never leave the local environment. Across 33 datasets spanning five scientific domains, SPHERE protects individual privacy against adversarial re-identification attacks while preserving the data's statistical structure: means, variances and correlations are reproduced exactly, effect size and P value in linear statistical analysis is numerically identical, nonlinear machine-learning utility is retained, and each twin is generated in seconds on a laptop. Frontier AI agents running on the twin reach the same scientific conclusions as on the original records. Analyses of the twin reproduce genome- and proteome-wide results at UK Biobank scale and recover the findings of landmark studies across three independent cohorts and consortia. The approach also extends to deep-learning embeddings across language, vision and time-series, with minimal utility loss. We make the Stanford Alzheimer's Disease Research Center cohort openly available for the first time, as a SPHERE twin spanning nine modalities that any registered researcher can analyze without an approval process. We release SPHERE with certification of each twin's privacy and fidelity, and an AI agent that autonomously executes research tasks on sensitive data without ever accessing it. Sensitive datasets that are currently closed to research could thus become routine inputs to open science and AI to enable key discoveries.
items.summary_zh: SPHERE提出无模型的敏感数据“合成孪生”方法，在33个数据集上报告能抵御重识别攻击并保留统计与机器学习效用，同时使AI智能体在孪生数据上得出与原始记录相同的科学结论。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 若其隐私和效用主张可被独立复现，该方法可能降低多模态人类数据共享的壁垒；但安全性与结论等价性均是作者在预印本中的报告，仍需独立审计。
items.abstract_zh: 敏感人类数据支撑医学、生物学和社会科学中的发现，但隐私法规往往阻碍与合作者或人工智能（AI）系统共享这些数据。我们提出SPHERE，这是一种无模型方法，可将敏感数据集作为合成孪生直接供AI使用并用于开放科学共享，而原始记录永不离开本地环境。在覆盖五个科学领域的33个数据集上，SPHERE在对抗性重识别攻击中保护个人隐私，同时保留数据的统计结构：均值、方差和相关性被精确再现，线性统计分析中的效应量和P值在数值上完全一致，非线性机器学习效用得到保留，并且每个孪生可在笔记本电脑上数秒内生成。在孪生数据上运行的前沿AI智能体得出与原始记录相同的科学结论。对孪生数据的分析在UK Biobank尺度上再现了全基因组和全蛋白质组结果，并在三个独立队列和联盟中恢复了里程碑研究的发现。该方法还扩展到语言、视觉和时间序列的深度学习嵌入，效用损失极小。我们首次使斯坦福阿尔茨海默病研究中心队列以SPHERE孪生形式向所有注册研究者开放；该孪生覆盖九种模态，任何注册研究者都可在无需审批流程的情况下分析。我们发布SPHERE，并为每个孪生提供其隐私和保真度认证，以及一个可在从不访问敏感数据的情况下自主对敏感数据执行研究任务的AI智能体。目前对研究关闭的敏感数据集因此可能成为开放科学和AI的常规输入，以推动关键发现。

items.summary_zh: Jerry Tworek 提出一种观点：开源软件可让模型训练公司免费训练模型使用并优化该软件，因此可能形成偏向开源工具的生态优势；Blender 的结论是其推测。

items.abstract_zh: 开源带来的一个意外好处是，它让模型训练公司可以免费训练模型来使用你的软件（并对其进行优化）。Blender 或许刚刚已经赢得了3D资产创作软件之争，因为模型会比使用任何专有软件时更擅长使用它。

items.abstract_or_text: The narrative around why building AGI was a good idea has always been about invention -- "it will cure cancer", "it will solve fusion energy", etc. So I would not "declare AGI" until we have AI that is, at last, capable of invention -- conceptual breakthroughs, novel insights, new real-world technology, etc.
items.summary_zh: François Chollet 认为，只有当 AI 能产生概念突破、新洞见或新现实技术等“发明”时，才应宣称实现 AGI；这是其提出的判定标准，而非能力已被证明的事实。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该观点将 AGI 的讨论从解决既有任务转向产生可验证的新知识，为能力评估和科学发现叙事提供了更严格的标准。
items.abstract_zh: 围绕建造 AGI 为何是好主意的叙事，一直都关乎发明——“它会治愈癌症”“它会解决聚变能源”等等。因此，在 AI 终于能够发明之前——能够带来概念突破、新洞见、新的现实世界技术等——我不会“宣布 AGI”。

items.title: BOTANIC-1: a series of long-context plant genomic foundation models in the agentic era
items.abstract_or_text: The development of climate-resilient crops would be greatly accelerated by models able to reason directly over plant genomic sequences and to pinpoint trait-associated regions or loci. Anticipating the impact of DNA base changes (variants) remains challenging, and understanding regulatory mechanisms is still an active area of research. Through self-supervised training on unannotated genomic data, genomic language models (gLMs) can learn DNA syntax and grammar that go beyond current annotations, thus complementing standard bioinformatics analyses that rely on rules established by decades of genomics research. Here we present our agent-powered Model Factory and its first outputs: the Botanic1 family of gLMs designed for plant research, which operates reliably on sequences from hundreds of base pairs up to 128 kbp. These models outperform all generalist and plant-specific gLMs (as well as specialised baselines) on one of the largest sets of plant genomics evaluation tasks reported to date, at a much smaller budget than concurrent models. Mechanistic interpretability analysis identifies features associated with biologically meaningful sequence properties including coding region boundaries and splice site motifs, demonstrating that these models are a source of biological insight beyond their benchmark performance. Finally, because a gLM only becomes practically useful when embedded in a broader workflow, we integrate Botanic1 as a specialised genomic layer callable by a generalist large language model (LLM) agent, illustrating how such hybrid systems could accelerate plant biology research. To support the plant genomics research community, we will release Botanic1-S, Botanic1-M and Botanic1-L for research use at https://huggingface.co/collections/living-models/botanic1-6a97f4e3c33f3d109a75057d
items.summary_zh: BOTANIC-1发布面向植物研究的长上下文基因组语言模型系列，可处理数百bp至128 kbp序列，并报告在大规模植物基因组学任务上优于通用及植物专用基线。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把长序列建模、可解释性分析和可由通用LLM调用的专用基因组层结合，为性状相关位点与调控序列研究提供开放的预训练模型资源。
items.abstract_zh: 如果模型能够直接对植物基因组序列进行推理并定位与性状相关的区域或位点，气候适应性作物的开发将大大加速。预测DNA碱基改变（变异）的影响仍具挑战性，对调控机制的理解仍是活跃研究领域。通过在未注释基因组数据上进行自监督训练，基因组语言模型（gLMs）可以学习超出现有注释范围的DNA句法和语法，从而补充依赖数十年基因组学研究所建立规则的标准生物信息学分析。我们在此介绍由智能体驱动的Model Factory及其首批产出：为植物研究设计的Botanic1 gLM家族，其可在数百个碱基对至128 kbp的序列上可靠运行。这些模型在迄今报道的最大植物基因组学评估任务集之一上优于所有通用和植物专用gLM以及专用基线，同时预算远低于同期模型。机制可解释性分析识别出与具有生物学意义的序列属性相关的特征，包括编码区边界和剪接位点基序，表明这些模型除基准表现外还能提供生物学洞见。最后，由于gLM只有嵌入更广泛的工作流才具有实际用途，我们将Botanic1整合为可由通用大语言模型（LLM）智能体调用的专用基因组层，说明此类混合系统如何加速植物生物学研究。为支持植物基因组学研究群体，我们将发布Botanic1-S、Botanic1-M和Botanic1-L供研究使用，网址为https://huggingface.co/collections/living-models/botanic1-6a97f4e3c33f3d109a75057d。

items.title: Benchmark validity in graph neural network scoring of metabolic reaction activity on Recon3D: detecting label leakage, memorized noise and input-invariant models
items.abstract_or_text: Context-specific genome-scale metabolic modeling begins with scoring which of the approximately 10,600 human reactions are active in a patient's tumor. Methods in this literature are routinely benchmarked against activity labels obtained by thresholding the same transcriptomic matrix that is supplied to the model as input. We report a self-audit of our own graph attention scorer, MetaGNN, evaluated on TCGA colorectal (n=624), breast (n=1,095) and lung adenocarcinoma (n=517) cohorts, in which two independent failure modes produced a near-ceiling benchmark score and a positive architectural result, neither of which survived inspection. First, under expression-thresholded supervision the framework reaches AUROC 0.9864 +/- 0.0008 on TCGA-BRCA. That figure partitions into 5,925 reactions whose labels are a deterministic threshold of the model's own input, where ranking by the cohort-mean input alone gives AUROC 1.000; and 4,675 reactions whose stored labels we reproduce bit for bit from a seeded pseudo-random number generator, where the model nonetheless reaches 0.9291 +/- 0.0030 by memorizing a patient-invariant label vector that patient-level splitting leaves fully visible during training. Second, on the cohort supervised independently of the input, the archived models never received patient data at all. Their released feature tensors are uniformly zero, and independently trained models show no agreement on which patient deviates where (|r| <= 0.004 on per-patient output residuals, against r = +0.32 between output and input residuals on expression-bearing reactions for a model with verified features). A dispersion ratio comparing between-patient output spread against Monte Carlo Dropout sampling spread sits at 1.02 to 1.03 for all three configurations, against a no-signal null of 1.02 and 2.44 for the verified model. We therefore withdraw a +0.105 AUROC gain attributed to relational edges in an earlier draft of this work. Retraining on rebuilt, verified features gives AUROC 0.5800 +/- 0.0017, below both the raw-expression baseline of 0.6342 +/- 0.0058 that we establish for this cohort and an information-free indicator baseline of 0.6085. Zero-shot transfer of the BRCA model is at or below chance on METABRIC microarray (0.4926 +/- 0.0113, n=200) and on same-platform CPTAC-BRCA RNA-seq (0.4986, n=106). We release the code, the curated colorectal cohort, a script that replays the label vector from its generating seed, and the screening checks we now run before reporting any score. Source code: https://github.com/thiptanawat/MetaGNN-Framework (MIT).
items.summary_zh: MetaGNN作者对自身肿瘤代谢反应活性评分基准进行复核，发现表达阈值标签泄漏、伪随机标签记忆和零特征输入等失败模式，并撤回先前的性能增益。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作用可复放代码、标签生成回放和多队列检验具体展示了生物医学GNN评测可能如何失真，是提升模型审计与基准可复现性的直接案例。
items.abstract_zh: 特定背景下的全基因组尺度代谢建模始于对患者肿瘤中约10,600个反应哪些处于活跃状态进行评分。该领域的方法通常针对通过对作为模型输入的同一转录组矩阵进行阈值化所得到的活性标签进行基准评测。我们报告了对自身图注意力评分器MetaGNN的自我审计；该模型在TCGA结直肠癌（n=624）、乳腺癌（n=1,095）和肺腺癌（n=517）队列上评估，其中两种独立失败模式产生了近乎封顶的基准分数和正面的架构结果，但两者均未能经受检查。首先，在表达阈值化监督下，该框架在TCGA-BRCA上达到AUROC 0.9864 +/- 0.0008。该数值可分为5,925个反应，其标签是模型自身输入的确定性阈值，对其仅按队列均值输入排序即可获得AUROC 1.000；以及4,675个反应，其存储标签可由播种伪随机数发生器逐位重现，而模型仍可通过记忆一个在患者级划分下训练期间完全可见的患者不变标签向量达到0.9291 +/- 0.0030。第二，在使用独立于输入的监督的队列上，归档模型从未接收到患者数据。其发布的特征张量全部为零，且独立训练的模型对哪些患者在哪些位置偏离毫无一致性（每位患者输出残差的|r|<=0.004；对于特征已验证模型中具有表达的反应，输出与输入残差之间r=+0.32）。在全部三种配置中，比较患者间输出离散度与Monte Carlo Dropout采样离散度的离散比为1.02至1.03，而无信号零假设为1.02，已验证模型为2.44。因此，我们撤回先前版本中归因于关系边的+0.105 AUROC增益。使用重建且经过验证的特征重新训练得到AUROC 0.5800 +/- 0.0017，低于我们为该队列建立的原始表达基线0.6342 +/- 0.0058和无信息指示器基线0.6085。BRCA模型的零样本迁移在METABRIC微阵列（0.4926 +/- 0.0113，n=200）和同平台CPTAC-BRCA RNA-seq（0.4986，n=106）上均处于或低于随机水平。我们发布代码、经整理的结直肠癌队列、从其生成种子回放标签向量的脚本，以及我们现在在报告任何分数前运行的筛查检查。源代码：https://github.com/thiptanawat/MetaGNN-Framework（MIT）。

items.title: OmniSyn unifies target-aware molecular generation and optimization within a synthesis-native LLM framework across the human proteome
items.abstract_or_text: Designing target-specific bioactive molecules with actionable synthesis routes for the human proteome holds enormous potential for expanding therapeutic discovery, but remains a challenge. Existing target-aware generative models often depend on protein structures and generate molecules before assessing synthetic feasibility. Here we present OmniSyn, a protein-sequence-conditioned Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model that couples a task-conditioned interaction module with a synthesis-action decoder to generate molecules with explicit synthesis traces, thereby unifying de novo ligand generation, synthesizability projection and hit-to-lead (H2L) optimization within synthesis-traceable chemical space. OmniSyn is pre-trained with self-distillation and post-trained with task-specific reinforcement learning (RL) to adapt expert routing and optimize molecular properties across design modes. On unseen protein targets from MolGenBench, a real-world drug-discovery benchmark, OmniSyn achieves state-of-the-art performance across de novo design and H2L optimization, including target-awareness and hit-rediscovery metrics, despite relying only on protein sequences rather than three-dimensional (3D) pocket structures. By embedding synthesis planning into the design process, OmniSyn shifts molecular generation from a generate-then-filter paradigm toward design-with-synthesis paradigm, transforming virtual predictions into experimentally actionable candidates. Independent AiZynthFinder evaluation yielded retrosynthetic success rates of 68.47% for de novo generation and 71.92% for H2L optimization, improving over the strongest baselines by 61.3% and 184.2%, respectively, and supporting the synthetic feasibility of OmniSyn-generated molecules. In synthesizability projection, OmniSyn further converts outputs from external generative models into close analogues with improved retrosynthetic feasibility while preserving molecular similarity. Having established strong benchmark performance and external retrosynthetic feasibility, we next applied OmniSyn at human-proteome scale, spanning more than 21,000 targets. Rapid sequence-conditioned sampling enabled the construction of, to our knowledge, the largest human-proteome-scale generative virtual library, comprising 2.7 billion target-specific molecules, each accompanied by model-derived synthesis traces and target-specific prioritization scores. By enabling scalable target-specific molecular design with synthesis-aware generation across the human proteome, OmniSyn opens new opportunities for exploring previously inaccessible therapeutic targets, including those lacking experimentally resolved structures.
items.summary_zh: OmniSyn 将蛋白序列条件分子生成、合成轨迹生成、可合成性投影与 hit-to-lead 优化整合到 MoE 语言模型中，并在 MolGenBench 未见靶点和全人类蛋白组尺度进行评估。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把合成规划前置到靶向设计有望缩短“生成后筛选”链路；但结果仍主要来自基准和 AiZynthFinder 外部回合成评估，2.7 billion 分子库及其药理价值尚未逐一实验验证。
items.abstract_zh: 为人类蛋白组设计具有可执行合成路线的靶点特异性生物活性分子，具有扩大治疗发现的巨大潜力，但仍是一项挑战。现有靶点感知生成模型通常依赖蛋白质结构，并在评估合成可行性之前生成分子。这里我们提出 OmniSyn：一种以蛋白序列为条件的 Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) 语言模型。它将任务条件化相互作用模块与合成动作解码器耦合，以生成带有明确合成轨迹的分子，从而在可追溯合成的化学空间中统一从头配体生成、可合成性投影和 hit-to-lead (H2L) 优化。OmniSyn 通过自蒸馏进行预训练，并通过任务特异性强化学习 (RL) 进行后训练，以适应专家路由并在不同设计模式下优化分子性质。在真实世界药物发现基准 MolGenBench 的未见蛋白靶点上，OmniSyn 在从头设计和 H2L 优化中均实现了最先进的性能，包括靶点感知和命中物再发现指标，尽管它仅依赖蛋白序列而非三维 (3D) 口袋结构。通过将合成规划嵌入设计过程，OmniSyn 将分子生成从“先生成后筛选”范式转向“连同合成一起设计”范式，把虚拟预测转化为可实验操作的候选物。独立的 AiZynthFinder 评估显示，从头生成和 H2L 优化的逆合成成功率分别为 68.47% 和 71.92%，相对于最强基线分别提高 61.3% 和 184.2%，支持了 OmniSyn 所生成分子的合成可行性。在可合成性投影中，OmniSyn 还可将外部生成模型的输出转化为具有更好逆合成可行性、同时保持分子相似性的近似类似物。在确立强大的基准性能和外部逆合成可行性之后，我们将 OmniSyn 应用于全人类蛋白组尺度，覆盖超过 21,000 个靶点。快速的序列条件采样使我们构建了据我们所知最大的人类蛋白组尺度生成虚拟库，包含 2.7 billion 个靶点特异性分子，每个分子均附带模型生成的合成轨迹和靶点特异性优先级评分。通过在整个人类蛋白组中实现带有合成感知生成的可扩展靶点特异性分子设计，OmniSyn 为探索此前难以触及的治疗靶点开辟了新机会，其中包括缺少实验解析结构的靶点。

items.title: Zinc Redox Catalysis in the Photochemical Borylation of Fluorocarbons
items.abstract_or_text: Zinc compounds are ubiquitous in synthesis and materials. They find applications as reagents, catalysts, porous materials and as metalloenzymes — all of which rely on the properties of redox stable and electrophilic zinc(II) centres. In this paper we report the first clear example of redox catalysis involving reversible changes between zinc(I) and zinc(II) oxidation states. Under photochemical conditions a zinc(I) compound was shown to react with aryl fluorides. Turnover was achieved through addition of a diborane reagent, resulting in a catalytic borylation of the C(sp 2 )–F bonds of aryl fluorides. The reaction has a large scope including both electron-deficient and electron-rich aryl fluorides and tolerates a range of functional groups including ethers, amines, heteroaromatics, substituted alkenes and a strained ring-system. These findings were further exploited in the late-stage functionalisation of fluorinated molecules relevant to drug discovery and materials technologies, along the selective, stepwise, borylation of poly(fluorinated) arenes. Experiments and DFT calculations support a catalytic cycle involving changes between the zinc(I) and zinc(II) oxidation state. A zinc(II) boryl intermediate was isolated and shown to play a key role in reformation of the low-oxidation state zinc(I) species. The findings advance our fundamental understanding of redox catalysis with non-transition metal elements and set the foundation for further applications of zinc redox catalysts in challenging chemical transformations.
items.summary_zh: 研究报告 Zn(I)/Zn(II) 可逆氧化态变化参与的光化学氧化还原催化，以 diborane 实现芳基氟化物 C(sp2)–F 键催化硼化，并以实验和 DFT 支持催化循环。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 为通常被视为氧化还原稳定的 zinc 引入了可利用的低价态催化机制，并可用于含氟分子的后期修饰；但该结果为预印本，底物范围和机理证据仍需同行评议与独立复现。
items.abstract_zh: 锌化合物在合成和材料中无处不在。它们作为试剂、催化剂、多孔材料和金属酶得到应用——所有这些都依赖于氧化还原稳定且具亲电性的 zinc(II) 中心的性质。本文报道了第一个明确的氧化还原催化实例，涉及 zinc(I) 与 zinc(II) 氧化态之间的可逆变化。在光化学条件下，显示 zinc(I) 化合物可与芳基氟化物反应。通过加入 diborane 试剂实现催化周转，从而对芳基氟化物的 C(sp 2 )–F 键进行催化硼化。该反应具有广泛底物范围，包括缺电子和富电子芳基氟化物，并耐受包括醚、胺、杂芳烃、取代烯烃和张力环系在内的一系列官能团。这些发现还被用于与药物发现和材料技术相关的含氟分子的后期官能化，以及多(氟化)芳烃的选择性逐步硼化。实验和 DFT 计算支持一个涉及 zinc(I) 与 zinc(II) 氧化态变化的催化循环。一个 zinc(II) boryl 中间体被分离，并被证明在低氧化态 zinc(I) 物种的再生成中起关键作用。这些发现推进了我们对非过渡金属元素氧化还原催化的基础理解，并为 zinc 氧化还原催化剂在具挑战性化学转化中的进一步应用奠定基础。
items.author_line: Wenbang Yang, Aaranjah Vickneswaran, Alick Birmingham-Conner, Mark Richard Crimmin

items.title: MorphoNavigator-3D: Generalizable single-cell phenotyping of cancer spheroids using Bayesian-optimized deep-learning workflows
items.abstract_or_text: Accurate quantification of drug responses in 3D tumor-immune co-cultures remains challenging because complex spatial architecture and cellular heterogeneity limit the interpretability of bulk viability assays. Here, we present MorphoNavigator-3D ('Morphological Navigator in 3D';MoNa-3D), an automated framework for high-resolution, annotation-free single-cell analysis in complex 3D co-cultures. The approach integrates optimized live-cell staining, deep learning-based segmentation, and Bayesian optimization (BO) to adapt end-to-end image-analysis workflows across diverse experimental conditions. MoNa-3D was applied to clear cell renal cell carcinoma (ccRCC)-immune cell 3D-spheroid co-cultures, exposed to PI3K/mTOR pathway inhibitors and immunomodulatory compounds in a high-content imaging-based drug screen. The pipeline was used to extract multiscale phenotypic features encompassing ATP-based cell viability, morphology, nuclear remodeling, spatial dispersion, and immune infiltration. This analysis resolved distinct drug-induced phenotypes: PI3K/mTOR inhibitors promoted spheroid disintegration, nuclear enlargement, and immune exclusion, whereas immunomodulators preserved spheroid architecture and T-cell engagement. Multivariate phenotypic integration distinguished drug classes and revealed intra-class variation, including divergent spatial responses to dual PI3K/mTOR versus mTORC1 inhibition. These phenotypes were consistent with known drug mechanisms, supporting the biological interpretability of the framework. Together, these findings establish MoNa-3D as a generalizable platform for multidimensional phenotypic profiling across complex 3D multicellular systems, supporting applications in drug discovery, tumor-immune interaction studies, and precision oncology.
items.summary_zh: MorphoNavigator-3D将活细胞染色、深度学习分割和贝叶斯优化组合，用于肾透明细胞癌—免疫细胞3D球状体共培养中的无标注单细胞表型分析及药物筛选。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该框架将空间结构、细胞形态、活性和免疫浸润纳入同一高内涵分析，适合比较复杂肿瘤—免疫体系中的候选药物表型；机制解释仍主要来自与既有药理知识的一致性。
items.abstract_zh: 由于复杂的空间结构和细胞异质性限制了整体存活率测定的可解释性，在3D肿瘤—免疫共培养物中准确量化药物反应仍具挑战。我们在此提出MorphoNavigator-3D（“三维形态导航仪”；MoNa-3D），这是一个用于复杂3D共培养物中高分辨率、无注释单细胞分析的自动化框架。该方法整合优化的活细胞染色、基于深度学习的分割和贝叶斯优化（BO），以使端到端图像分析工作流适应多样实验条件。MoNa-3D被应用于肾透明细胞癌（ccRCC）—免疫细胞3D球状体共培养物；这些共培养物暴露于PI3K/mTOR通路抑制剂和免疫调节化合物，并接受基于高内涵成像的药物筛选。该流程用于提取多尺度表型特征，涵盖基于ATP的细胞活性、形态、细胞核重塑、空间离散和免疫浸润。该分析解析出不同的药物诱导表型：PI3K/mTOR抑制剂促进球状体解体、细胞核增大和免疫排斥，而免疫调节剂维持球状体结构和T细胞参与。多变量表型整合区分了药物类别，并揭示类别内变异，包括双重PI3K/mTOR抑制与mTORC1抑制之间不同的空间反应。这些表型与已知药物机制一致，支持该框架的生物学可解释性。总之，这些发现将MoNa-3D确立为一个可泛化的平台，可在复杂3D多细胞系统中进行多维表型分析，支持其在药物发现、肿瘤—免疫相互作用研究和精准肿瘤学中的应用。

items.title: @ycombinator：Harnesses often get dismissed as just scaffolding, just prompt engineering, and not real research. But that couldn't be
items.abstract_or_text: Harnesses often get dismissed as just scaffolding, just prompt engineering, and not real research. But that couldn't be farther from the truth. The same model weights that score 30% on ARC-AGI score 95% with a better harness. So we gathered a group of researchers and founders working at the frontier to do a deep dive into the state of harnesses. We cover how we got to this point, the case for making your harness as expressive as possible, and what YC learned building an agent for every employee in the company.
items.summary_zh: Y Combinator 主张不应把 harness 视为仅是提示工程或外围脚手架，并以“相同权重在更好 harness 下 ARC-AGI 从30%到95%”说明其重要性；该具体数字为帖文陈述。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 帖文把智能体性能讨论从模型权重扩展到执行环境、工具和任务编排，并提供了可供工程团队检验的论题。
evidence_flags: 性能数字需追溯原始证据
items.abstract_zh: Harness 常被轻视为只是脚手架、只是提示工程，而不是真正的研究。但这完全不对。同一组模型权重，在 ARC-AGI 上原本得分30%，使用更好的 harness 后可得95%。因此我们召集了一批在前沿工作的研究者和创始人，深入讨论 harness 的现状。我们涵盖了行业如何走到今天、为何应让 harness 尽可能具备表达力，以及 YC 在为公司每位员工构建智能体时学到了什么。

items.title: A retrieval-augmented agent bridges virtual screening and automated synthesis
items.abstract_or_text: Translating virtually designed drug molecules into executable synthesis protocols is essential for connecting computational discovery with automated synthesis. However, most retrosynthesis methods focus on precursor generation, offer limited route diversity, and lack the detailed reaction conditions required for executable protocols. Here, we present Syn-RRAG, a retrieval-augmented LLM-driven synthesis agent connecting virtual screening with automated synthesis and validation. Syn-RRAG integrates initial retrosynthetic prediction, reaction-precedent retrieval and hierarchical refinement to generate structured protocols with complete experimental parameters. Its local generative model searches over complete reaction hypotheses rather than relying solely on token-level beam search, enabling exploration of feasible routes with distinct reaction classes and bond disconnections. It achieved strong retrosynthesis performance on two patent-derived reaction datasets. Syn-RRAG further generated executable plans for three virtually screened drug candidates, all of which were synthesized and validated on an automated platform. These results establish a workflow connecting virtual molecular design, synthesis planning and experimental validation.
items.summary_zh: Syn-RRAG 是检索增强的 LLM 合成智能体：以初始逆合成、反应先例检索和分层细化生成包含完整实验参数的方案，并在自动化平台合成验证了 3 个虚拟筛选候选物。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作把虚拟筛选、路线设计与自动化实证连成闭环，且不只给出前体；但自动化验证样本仅 3 个，跨反应类型、底物空间和实验室的泛化性仍待检验。
items.abstract_zh: 将虚拟设计的药物分子转化为可执行的合成方案，对于连接计算发现与自动化合成至关重要。然而，大多数逆合成方法聚焦于前体生成，提供的路线多样性有限，并且缺少可执行方案所需的详细反应条件。这里，我们提出 Syn-RRAG：一种由检索增强 LLM 驱动的合成智能体，用于连接虚拟筛选、自动化合成和验证。Syn-RRAG 整合初始逆合成预测、反应先例检索和分层细化，以生成具有完整实验参数的结构化方案。其本地生成模型在完整反应假设上进行搜索，而非仅依赖 token 级束搜索，从而能够探索具有不同反应类别和成键断裂方式的可行路线。它在两个源自专利的反应数据集上获得了强劲的逆合成性能。Syn-RRAG 还为 3 个经虚拟筛选的药物候选物生成了可执行方案，且全部在自动化平台上完成合成和验证。这些结果建立了一条连接虚拟分子设计、合成规划和实验验证的工作流。
items.author_line: Shan Zhu, Xin Chen, Pinqi Wang, Quan Jiang, Mengzhu Li, Qimeng Wang, Guoyun Zhao, Yuan Qi, Fenglei Cao, Li-Cheng Xu

items.title: Heme-catalyzed Endogenous Activation of N-oxide Prodrugs
items.abstract_or_text: N-oxides are prominent functionalities in bioorthogonal prodrugs activated by exogenous stimuli such as boron reagents, X-ray, and ultrasound. However, N-oxide optical probes that are activated by endogenous heme and hemoproteins are recently reported, which has caused the existence of endogenous activation mechanism of N-oxide prodrugs to be overlooked or remain disputed. Here, we report a systemic study to examine the endogenous activation of N-oxide prodrugs in vitro, in liver microsomes, and in mice. We prepared four N-oxide prodrugs based on the synthetic molecule IOX5 and natural product derivative SN-38 with stable N-oxide moieties. We found that all the prodrugs could be catalytically reduced by heme and hemoproteins in vitro. The pharmacokinetics results indicated that all prodrugs could release the parent drugs in liver microsomes and animals. Notably, N-oxide prodrugs of SN-38, 7-1 and 8-40, exhibited dramatically improved oral bioavailability (23.3% and 18.7% for released SN-38) compared to SN-38 itself (0.07%). In the acute myeloid leukemia mice, oral administration of 7‑1 markedly reduced the leukemia burden and the percentage of leukemia stem cells, significantly prolonging the survival rate of leukemia mice. Overall, this study not only discloses that N-oxide prodrugs could be activated by endogenous heme, without any exogenous reagent or specific physiological condition, but also provides a modular and promising prodrug strategy to improve the oral bioavailability of poorly water-soluble drugs.
items.summary_zh: 该研究系统考察 heme/hemoproteins 对 N-oxide 前药的内源性还原激活，在肝微粒体和小鼠中验证 IOX5、SN-38 衍生物；SN-38 N-oxide 前药还在急性髓系白血病小鼠中显示疗效。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它提出无需外源触发剂的 N-oxide 前药激活路线，并报告显著提高 SN-38 口服生物利用度；但候选物的安全性、选择性和向人体转化尚无证据，不能据此推断临床效用。
items.abstract_zh: N-oxides 是生物正交前药中的重要官能团，可由 boron 试剂、X-ray 和 ultrasound 等外源刺激激活。然而，最近报道了可由内源性 heme 和 hemoproteins 激活的 N-oxide 光学探针，这使得 N-oxide 前药内源性激活机制的存在被忽视或仍存争议。这里，我们报告一项系统研究，考察 N-oxide 前药在体外、肝微粒体和小鼠中的内源性激活。我们制备了 4 种基于合成分子 IOX5 和天然产物衍生物 SN-38、带有稳定 N-oxide 基团的前药。我们发现，所有前药均可在体外被 heme 和 hemoproteins 催化还原。药代动力学结果表明，所有前药均可在肝微粒体和动物中释放母体药物。值得注意的是，SN-38 的 N-oxide 前药 7-1 和 8-40 的口服生物利用度显著提高（释放的 SN-38 分别为 23.3% 和 18.7%），相比之下 SN-38 本身为 0.07%。在急性髓系白血病小鼠中，口服给予 7‑1 显著降低了白血病负荷和白血病干细胞比例，并显著延长白血病小鼠的存活率。总体而言，本研究不仅揭示 N-oxide 前药可由内源性 heme 激活，而无需任何外源试剂或特定生理条件，还提供了一种模块化且有前景的前药策略，用于改善难溶于水药物的口服生物利用度。
items.author_line: Si Ha, Tingyu Guo, Feng Wang, Ke Li, Chong-Jing Zhang

items.title: Interpretable Machine Learning for Predicting Cytochrome P450 Mechanism-Based Inhibition
items.abstract_or_text: Cytochrome P450 (CYP450) enzymes play a crucial role in the metabolism of endogenous and exogenous compounds, and their inhibition can lead to clinically significant drug–drug interactions and adverse effects. Mechanism-based inhibition (MBI) is a time-dependent form of CYP450 inhibition in which enzyme-mediated bioactivation of an inhibitor can result in persistent or irreversible enzyme inactivation. Early identification of compounds with MBI liability is therefore important for reducing metabolic and drug–drug interaction risks during drug discovery. In this study, a curated dataset of 569 unique MBI compounds was compiled from the literature, while non-mechanism-based inhibitors (NMBIs) were obtained from PubChem. To construct a chemically diverse negative dataset, Butina clustering-based sampling was employed. Molecular representations based on RDKit and Mordred descriptors, MACCS keys, and ECFP fingerprints were evaluated using five machine learning algorithms, with feature selection and model optimization applied systematically. CYP-aware stratified splitting was employed to ensure appropriate representation of CYP isoform–class combinations across the training and test sets, and its performance was compared with random stratified splitting. Among the evaluated molecular representations, RDKit descriptors generally provided the strongest predictive performance, with optimized models achieving test-set ROC-AUC values of up to 0.92 in the CYP-aware evaluation. Applicability-domain analysis further demonstrated higher prediction accuracy for compounds within the defined chemical space, supporting the reliability of predictions for structurally represented compounds. In addition, structural-alert analysis identified class-associated structural motifs, including statistically significant alerts preferentially associated with MBI compounds, providing chemically interpretable information complementary to the machine learning models. Evaluation using the expanded MBI569 dataset further assessed the robustness of the predictive models across different dataset sizes and splitting strategies. Overall, this study demonstrates a systematic and interpretable approach for predicting CYP450 mechanism-based inhibition, with potential utility for the early identification of MBI liabilities during drug discovery.
items.summary_zh: 研究以 569 个文献整理的 mechanism-based inhibition (MBI) 化合物构建 CYP450 风险预测框架，比较描述符、指纹与五种机器学习算法，并通过 CYP-aware 划分和结构警报增强可解释性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: CYP450 MBI 是重要的药物代谢和药物相互作用风险；其 ROC-AUC 最高为 0.92，且考虑了适用域。限制在于负例来自 PubChem、标签和划分策略仍可能影响外推，模型不能替代实验性代谢评估。
items.abstract_zh: Cytochrome P450 (CYP450) 酶在内源性和外源性化合物的代谢中发挥关键作用，而其抑制可导致具有临床意义的药物–药物相互作用和不良反应。Mechanism-based inhibition (MBI) 是 CYP450 抑制的一种时间依赖性形式，其中抑制剂经酶介导的生物活化可导致酶持续性或不可逆失活。因此，在药物发现早期识别具有 MBI 风险的化合物，对于降低代谢和药物–药物相互作用风险很重要。在本研究中，从文献汇编了包含 569 个独特 MBI 化合物的整理数据集，而非机制型抑制剂 (NMBIs) 来自 PubChem。为构建化学多样的负数据集，采用基于 Butina 聚类的采样。评估了基于 RDKit 和 Mordred 描述符、MACCS keys 及 ECFP fingerprints 的分子表示，并系统应用特征选择和模型优化。采用 CYP-aware 分层划分，以确保 CYP isoform–class 组合在训练集和测试集间得到适当表示，并将其性能与随机分层划分比较。在所评估的分子表示中，RDKit 描述符通常提供最强预测性能；在 CYP-aware 评估中，优化模型的测试集 ROC-AUC 最高达 0.92。适用域分析进一步表明，在定义的化学空间内，化合物具有更高预测准确性，支持了对结构被代表的化合物进行预测的可靠性。此外，结构警报分析识别出与类别相关的结构基序，包括优先与 MBI 化合物相关的统计学显著警报，为机器学习模型提供化学上可解释的补充信息。使用扩展的 MBI569 数据集的评估进一步评估了预测模型在不同数据集规模和划分策略下的鲁棒性。总体而言，本研究展示了一种系统且可解释的方法来预测 CYP450 mechanism-based inhibition，可能有助于在药物发现早期识别 MBI 风险。
items.author_line: Khushashish Bhasin, Sudham Engle, Devendra Kumar Dhaked

items.title: Optical compression of multimodal clinical data into a unified visual memory for generative trajectory forecasting
items.abstract_or_text: Importance. Current clinical artificial intelligence is bottlenecked by highly specialized, fragmented models that reduce complex, multimodal data into isolated scalar predictions. By reframing multimodal perception as a pure vision problem, optical compression into a universal visual operating system can resolve internal data interaction bottlenecks and shift the paradigm toward continuous, generative clinical forecasting. Objective. To develop and internally validate Clinical Visual Memory, a generalist visual foundation model utilizing high-fidelity optical compression to fuse five heterogeneous intensive care unit (ICU) data modalities into a unified visual-token space, acting as a generative navigation system for critical-care trajectories. Design, Setting, and Participants. Retrospective modeling study using MIMIC-IV adult ICU encounters. After excluding stays shorter than 24 hours, 54,551 patients, 68,546 hospital admissions, and 74,829 ICU stays comprised the eligible cohort. Strict patient-level partitioning prevented cross-split leakage. Methods. Structured electronic health record (EHR) data, vital signs, 10-second electrocardiogram (ECG) waveforms, chest radiographs, and clinical notes were rendered as 2D images and encoded by a single frozen DINOv2 vision transformer. Through modality-aware latent-query cross-attention, these highly heterogeneous sources were optically compressed into a shared 1024-dimensional Clinical Visual Memory. To establish a universal output interface, this memory conditioned an conditional instruction-tuned image generator to decode eight-domain deterioration trajectories across 3- to 48-hour horizons. Visual compression fidelity was evaluated by reducing retained source-pixel area to 1%, and critical transitions were mapped using event-specific projected-axis geometry. Results. Operating as a generalist foundation, Clinical Visual Memory achieved AUROCs of 0.852 (95% CI, 0.821-0.882) for 48-hour mortality, 0.699 (0.673-0.725) for incident acute kidney injury (AKI), 0.723 (0.688-0.757) for high Sequential Organ Failure Assessment (SOFA), and 0.742 (0.726-0.757) for alive ICU discharge. Crucially, resolving the token bottleneck via an 8-fold reduction in source-pixel area preserved 98.9% of the uncompressed 48-hour mortality AUROC. Generative image-out decoding maintained clinical meaning, and trajectory geometry functioned as a proactive navigation system, yielding median warning lead times of 34.8 hours (IQR, 17.5-43.3) before death, 14.6 hours (6.5-33.2) before AKI, 15.0 hours (6.0-27.0) before high SOFA, and 20.8 hours (10.2-36.0) before recovery, with low false-alert burdens (0.040-0.109 per patient-day). Conclusions and Relevance. Clinical Visual Memory demonstrates that optical compression can successfully unify highly heterogeneous clinical data into a single, high-fidelity visual-token representation. By functioning as a continuous clinical navigation system rather than a discrete alert generator, this framework lays the architectural foundation for a generalist, generative visual operating system in critical care medicine. External and prospective validation are required before clinical deployment.
items.summary_zh: Clinical Visual Memory将ICU电子病历、生命体征、10秒ECG、胸片和临床文本渲染为图像，并在MIMIC-IV的74,829次ICU住院中以统一视觉令牌预测多类短期轨迹。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是对异质临床数据统一表征的规模化探索，采用患者级切分以避免泄漏；但证据来自回顾性内部验证，论文也明确要求外部和前瞻性验证后方可临床部署。
items.abstract_zh: 重要性：当前临床人工智能受制于高度专门化、碎片化的模型，这些模型将复杂的多模态数据降为孤立的标量预测。将多模态感知重新定义为纯视觉问题，通过光学压缩形成通用视觉操作系统，可以解决内部数据交互瓶颈，并将范式转向连续、生成式临床预测。目标：开发并进行内部验证Clinical Visual Memory，这是一种通用视觉基础模型，利用高保真光学压缩将五种异质重症监护病房（ICU）数据模态融合到统一视觉令牌空间中，作为危重症轨迹的生成式导航系统。设计、场景和参与者：使用MIMIC-IV成人ICU就诊记录进行的回顾性建模研究。排除住院时间短于24小时的记录后，54,551名患者、68,546次住院和74,829次ICU住院构成符合条件的队列。严格的患者级划分防止了跨集合泄漏。方法：将结构化电子健康记录（EHR）数据、生命体征、10秒心电图（ECG）波形、胸部X线片和临床笔记渲染为二维图像，并由单个冻结的DINOv2视觉Transformer编码。通过模态感知的潜在查询交叉注意力，这些高度异质的来源被光学压缩为共享的1024维Clinical Visual Memory。为建立通用输出接口，该记忆对一个条件化、指令调优的图像生成器进行条件化，以解码3至48小时预测范围内八个领域的恶化轨迹。通过将保留源像素面积降低至1%来评估视觉压缩保真度，并使用事件特异性投影轴几何映射关键转变。结果：作为通用基础模型，Clinical Visual Memory对48小时死亡率、发生急性肾损伤（AKI）、高序贯器官衰竭评估（SOFA）和存活ICU出院的AUROC分别为0.852（95% CI，0.821-0.882）、0.699（0.673-0.725）、0.723（0.688-0.757）和0.742（0.726-0.757）。关键的是，通过将源像素面积减少8倍来解决令牌瓶颈，保留了未压缩48小时死亡率AUROC的98.9%。生成式图像输出解码保持了临床含义，轨迹几何作为主动导航系统发挥作用，在死亡、AKI、高SOFA和恢复前分别产生34.8小时（IQR，17.5-43.3）、14.6小时（6.5-33.2）、15.0小时（6.0-27.0）和20.8小时（10.2-36.0）的中位预警提前时间，且假警报负担较低（每患者日0.040-0.109）。结论和相关性：Clinical Visual Memory表明，光学压缩可以成功地将高度异质的临床数据统一为单一的高保真视觉令牌表征。该框架作为连续临床导航系统而非离散警报生成器发挥作用，为重症医学中的通用、生成式视觉操作系统奠定了架构基础。临床部署前仍需要外部和前瞻性验证。

items.title: From code to natural language: MErlin - a multiomics toolkit for bacterial epigenomics delivered as Claude agent skill.
items.abstract_or_text: Interpreting a bacterial methylome is a multi-omics problem. It requires integrating modified-base calls with genome annotation, motif inventories, methyltransferase genotypes, transcript abundance, replichore position and, increasingly, chromosome conformation. These data types are commonly generated in incompatible formats, use inconsistent sequence and gene identifiers, and originate from different analytical workflows. The relevant algorithms are available, but assembling them into a coherent and statistically defensible analysis remains a substantial data-integration and interface problem. We present MErlin (Methylation-driven Expression & Regulation Linkage in Interacting Nuclear-domains), a multi-omics toolkit comprising seventeen composable modules, from basecalled modBAM files to ranked gene-level evidence and a self-contained HTML report. MErlin is distributed both as a conventional Python package and as an agent skill: a structured, version-controlled layer of procedural knowledge that enables a compatible large language model (LLM) assistant to select and operate the audited package without generating a new analysis implementation for each request. This design treats natural language as an interface to fixed analytical operations rather than as a substitute for tested scientific software. The skill encodes module-selection rules, mandatory preflight checks, questions that require human input, design-to-inference constraints, and interpretation guidance. We describe MErlin's architecture and statistics, validate it against a synthetic dataset with planted ground truth, and illustrate the conversational interface on a real methylome-transcriptome comparison in Pseudoalteromonas haloplanktis TAC125. MErlin is open source and available at https://github.com/IacopoPasseri/MErlin
items.summary_zh: MErlin提供17个可组合模块，将细菌甲基化组与注释、基序、甲基转移酶基因型、表达、复制体位置和染色体构象整合为排序的基因级证据及HTML报告。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 以版本控制的智能体技能作为经过审计软件的自然语言接口，且包含合成真值验证与开源代码，为细菌表观基因组多组学分析的可复现执行提供了实际资源。
items.abstract_zh: 解释细菌甲基化组是一个多组学问题。它要求将修饰碱基检测结果与基因组注释、基序目录、甲基转移酶基因型、转录本丰度、复制体位置以及日益重要的染色体构象整合起来。这些数据类型通常以不兼容的格式生成，使用不一致的序列和基因标识符，并源于不同的分析工作流。相关算法已经可用，但将它们组装成连贯且统计上可辩护的分析，仍是一个重大的数据整合和界面问题。我们提出MErlin（相互作用核域中的甲基化驱动表达与调控关联），这是一个由17个可组合模块构成的多组学工具包，覆盖从碱基识别后的modBAM文件到排序的基因级证据和独立HTML报告。MErlin既作为常规Python包发布，也作为智能体技能发布：后者是一个结构化、受版本控制的程序性知识层，使兼容的大语言模型（LLM）助手能够选择并运行经过审计的软件包，而无需针对每个请求生成新的分析实现。这一设计将自然语言视为固定分析操作的接口，而非经测试科学软件的替代品。该技能编码了模块选择规则、强制性预检、需要人工输入的问题、从设计到推断的约束以及解释指南。我们描述MErlin的架构和统计学，在带有植入真值的合成数据集上验证它，并在Pseudoalteromonas haloplanktis TAC125的一项真实甲基化组—转录组比较中展示对话式界面。MErlin为开源软件，网址为https://github.com/IacopoPasseri/MErlin。

items.title: High-throughput genomic feature extraction reveals environmental adaptations of prokaryotes
items.abstract_or_text: Understanding the adaptations of microorganisms to their environment is key to predicting the stability and dynamics of microbial communities. To uncover molecular mechanisms of environmental response, we extracted genomic features from 13,554 prokaryotic isolates, and trained machine learning models to identify which ones are most strongly associated with the microbial salinity, temperature, oxygen, and pH preferences. To extract these features in high throughput, including gene families, non-coding RNAs (ncRNAs), oligonucleotides, and amino acid usage, we built FxTractor, a scalable and adjustable pipeline available at: https://github.com/MGXlab/FxTractor. We validated the performance of our models with experimental data from a newly isolated deep-sea extremophile belonging to the genus Limnochorda that is not well-represented among the ML training sets, showing strong agreement between predictions and the conditions used to isolate this strain. Our analysis revealed specific gene and ncRNA families associated with each of the four environmental parameters, uncovering both established and potentially new molecular mechanisms. Examples include the bacterial large Signaling Recognition Particle in isolates that are able to grow at high temperatures ([≥]55{degrees}C), suggesting a role in translational pausing and structural stability under thermal stress. We also found the anti-hemB ncRNA to be associated with low-salinity (<0.7% NaCl), indicating a conserved antisense mechanism regulating the energetic costs of heme biosynthesis. Together, these findings provide new insights into microbe-environment interactions, and show how FxTractor enables high throughput discovery of genomic associations.
items.summary_zh: FxTractor从13,554株原核分离株提取基因家族、ncRNA、寡核苷酸和氨基酸使用等特征，建模预测盐度、温度、氧和pH偏好，并在新分离深海极端微生物中检验预测。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究把大规模比较基因组关联与训练集代表性不足的新菌株实验条件相对照，可生成微生物环境适应机制的候选假说。
items.abstract_zh: 理解微生物对环境的适应，是预测微生物群落稳定性和动态的关键。为了揭示环境响应的分子机制，我们从13,554株原核分离株中提取基因组特征，并训练机器学习模型，以识别与微生物盐度、温度、氧气和pH偏好关联最强的特征。为高通量提取这些特征，包括基因家族、非编码RNA（ncRNA）、寡核苷酸和氨基酸使用情况，我们构建了可扩展且可调节的FxTractor流程，网址为：https://github.com/MGXlab/FxTractor。我们利用一株新分离的、在机器学习训练集中代表性不足的Limnochorda属深海极端微生物的实验数据验证模型性能，预测结果与用于分离该菌株的条件高度一致。我们的分析揭示了与四种环境参数各自相关的特定基因和ncRNA家族，发现了既有的和潜在新的分子机制。例如，在能够于高温（≥55°C）生长的分离株中发现细菌大型信号识别颗粒，提示其在热胁迫下的翻译暂停和结构稳定性中发挥作用。我们还发现anti-hemB ncRNA与低盐度（<0.7% NaCl）相关，表明一种调控血红素生物合成能量成本的保守反义机制。总之，这些发现为微生物—环境相互作用提供了新见解，并显示FxTractor如何实现基因组关联的高通量发现。

items.title: Haplotype-resolved genome assembly of barberry reveals structural divergence and allele-specific expression during infection by wheat stripe rust pathogen
items.abstract_or_text: Barberry is an ecologically and medicinally important perennial shrub and an alternate host of Puccinia striiformis f. sp. tritici (Pst), the causal agent of wheat stripe rust. However, its genome architecture and molecular responses to Pst infection remain poorly understood. Here, we generated a haplotype-resolved, chromosome-level genome assembly of Berberis aggregata using PacBio HiFi and Hi-C sequencing. The two haplotypes, Ba5A and Ba5B, were assembled into 14 pseudochromosomes each, with genome sizes of approximately 1.13 and 1.16 Gb, respectively, and showed high continuity and completeness. Comparative analyses revealed extensive divergence between the haplotypes, including widespread structural variation, substantial hemizygosity, and TE-rich, gene-poor non-alignable regions. Haplotype-specific hemizygous genes also exhibited distinct functional biases, with Ba5A enriched in immune-related processes and Ba5B associated with transport and cell-envelope functions. Dual RNA-seq across infection stages revealed stage-dependent host transcriptional reprogramming, characterized by early pathogen perception followed by stronger defense activation and photosynthesis repression, whereas Pst displayed a coordinated colonization program consistent with its biotrophic lifestyle. Allele-specific expression analysis showed that ~25-28% of genes exhibited significant haplotype-biased expression, and a subset transitioned from unbiased expression at 0 dpi to Ba5A- or Ba5B-biased expression during infection. Integration with differential expression analysis further identified infection-responsive induced-biased genes associated with defense-related processes, including responses to fungal pathogens. These findings show that haplotype divergence and dynamic allele-specific regulation jointly contribute to transcriptional responses during Pst infection, providing new insights into the genomic basis of barberry-rust pathogen interactions.
items.summary_zh: 该研究用PacBio HiFi和Hi-C建立小檗的单倍型解析染色体级基因组，并以双RNA-seq解析其受小麦条锈菌感染时的阶段性表达重编程和等位基因偏倚表达。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 高连续性双单倍型参考与感染时序转录组共同揭示结构变异、半合子性和动态等位基因调控，为研究小檗—锈菌互作提供基因组资源。
items.abstract_zh: 小檗是一种具有生态和药用重要性的多年生灌木，也是小麦条锈病病原体Puccinia striiformis f. sp. tritici（Pst）的转主寄主。然而，其基因组结构和对Pst感染的分子反应仍知之甚少。我们在此利用PacBio HiFi和Hi-C测序，生成了Berberis aggregata的单倍型解析、染色体级基因组组装。两个单倍型Ba5A和Ba5B各自被组装为14条伪染色体，基因组大小分别约为1.13和1.16 Gb，并且具有很高的连续性和完整性。比较分析揭示两个单倍型之间存在广泛分化，包括广泛的结构变异、大量半合子性以及富含TE、基因贫乏的不可比对区域。单倍型特异性半合子基因也表现出不同的功能偏向，Ba5A富集于免疫相关过程，而Ba5B与转运和细胞包膜功能相关。跨越感染阶段的双RNA-seq揭示了阶段依赖的宿主转录重编程：早期为病原体感知，随后防御激活增强和光合作用受抑；而Pst则显示出与其专性寄生生活方式一致的协调定殖程序。等位基因特异性表达分析显示，约25-28%的基因表现出显著的单倍型偏倚表达，一部分基因从0 dpi时的无偏倚表达转变为感染期间的Ba5A或Ba5B偏倚表达。与差异表达分析进一步整合后，识别出与防御相关过程有关的、对感染有反应的诱导偏倚基因，其中包括对真菌病原体反应。这些发现表明，单倍型分化与动态等位基因特异性调控共同促进了对Pst感染的转录反应，为理解小檗—锈菌病原体相互作用的基因组基础提供了新见解。

items.abstract_or_text: 将大模型（似乎是算法）和Harness（似乎是工程）截然分开，可能是一种常见的误解。几年前，我基于 @lilianweng 2023年博客中的图，画了下面这张修订版。其中最重要的细节改动，就是大模型的框画成虚的：意思是，外面好像是大模型之外Harness的能力，有些完全可能训到大模型内部去，这取决于训练时数据和算法、算力的就绪程度。历史上，o1、R1这些推理模型还有最近agent能力的进展就是把原来在外面的规划训到大模型里去了，而编程能力可以认为是把工具里的代码解释器内化，长文本是记忆的内化，多模态、computer use是一部分环境感知和动作的内化……未来具身智能会有更多环境感知和动作内化。
items.summary_zh: 刘江认为，将大模型与 harness 绝对区分为算法和工程是一种误解，并提出规划、代码解释、记忆及部分环境感知和动作会随训练条件成熟而被逐步内化进模型。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这一分析为“模型能力与外部系统边界如何变化”提供了具体的历史性框架，可推动对训练、工具调用和具身智能分工的讨论。

items.title: Machine Learning for High-Throughput Reaction Yield Prediction in DNA-Encoded Library Synthesis
items.abstract_or_text: DNA-encoded library (DEL) synthesis relies on efficient DNA-compatible reactions to ensure library fidelity and the reliability of downstream affinity selection. However, most existing reaction yield prediction models were developed for general organic synthesis and typically use full-atom representations of complete reactants and products. In DEL single-cycle synthesis validation, an appropriate model reaction is to focus on the exposed reactive handle, its local chemical environment, the incoming building block (BB), and the reaction type, rather than large constant backgrounds such as the DNA tag, linker, and pre-existing scaffold. Here, we propose a functional-group-centric machine learning framework for DEL single-cycle reaction yield prediction. The model uses only the exposed substrate functional group (FG) and its coarse-grained local environment, the incoming BB, and the reaction type as inputs. Benchmarking on a real-world high-throughput DEL single-cycle validation dataset shows that graph neural network (GNN) models based on this localized representation outperform traditional fingerprint-based baselines, with a graph attention network (GAT) achieving the best overall performance and showing strong robustness on highly imbalanced industrial data. These results indicate that foregrounding the local reaction center is not merely a simplification of molecular representation, but a task-aligned strategy that better reflects the chemistry and decision logic of DEL single-cycle transformations. This lightweight framework is readily compatible with practical DEL workflows and provides valuable supports on reagent quality control (QC), building block selection, high-fidelity library design, and retrospective analysis of anomalous results.
items.summary_zh: 该研究为 DNA-encoded library (DEL) 单循环反应收率预测提出以暴露官能团、局部环境、building block (BB) 和反应类型为输入的局部表征；GAT 在真实高通量数据上优于指纹基线。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把表征与 DEL 单循环反应的实际决策单元对齐，可服务于 BB 选择和库质量控制；但结论限于给定工业数据集与单循环设定，不能直接外推至完整 DEL 合成路线。
items.abstract_zh: DNA-encoded library (DEL) 合成依赖高效的 DNA 兼容反应，以确保文库保真度和后续亲和筛选的可靠性。然而，大多数现有反应收率预测模型是为一般有机合成开发的，通常使用完整反应物和产物的全原子表示。在 DEL 单循环合成验证中，合适的模型反应应聚焦于暴露的反应把手、其局部化学环境、进入的 building block (BB) 和反应类型，而不是 DNA 标签、连接体和既有骨架等大型恒定背景。这里，我们提出一种以官能团为中心的机器学习框架，用于 DEL 单循环反应收率预测。该模型仅使用暴露的底物官能团 (FG) 及其粗粒化局部环境、进入的 BB 和反应类型作为输入。在一个真实世界高通量 DEL 单循环验证数据集上的基准测试表明，基于这种局部化表示的图神经网络 (GNN) 模型优于传统指纹基线，其中图注意力网络 (GAT) 实现了最佳总体性能，并在高度不平衡的工业数据上显示出强鲁棒性。这些结果表明，突出局部反应中心不只是对分子表示的简化，而是一种与任务相匹配的策略，能更好反映 DEL 单循环转化的化学和决策逻辑。这个轻量级框架可方便地兼容实际 DEL 工作流，并为试剂质量控制 (QC)、building block 选择、高保真文库设计和异常结果的回顾性分析提供有价值的支持。
items.author_line: Tao Tang, Li Gao, Sen Gao, Hongyao Zhu, Guansai Liu, Jin Li, Xuemin Cheng

items.title: TAME: Element-wise Mixture-of-Experts Fusion for Reliable and Interpretable Molecular Property Prediction
items.abstract_or_text: Property prediction for molecules and materials is bottlenecked by label scarcity, and in this regime the operative failure mode is not a low mean but an unpredictable tail: individual training runs collapse. The three dominant molecular representations fail in complementary ways—physicochemical descriptors are exact but fixed, graph neural networks learn topology but degenerate under sparse supervision, and language models supply semantic context but cannot compute exact quantities— yet combining them is itself the learning problem, because modality-level scalar gating commits the whole model to one trust weight per source. We introduce TAME , a tri-modal encoder whose element-wise Mixture-of-Experts router assigns an independent modality mixture to every hidden coordinate, stabilized by a balance–entropy regularizer, a closed-form gate initialization (β = log τ ) that is intended to remove router burn-in, and two-stage self-supervised graph pretraining. On scaffold-split BACE (≈ 1.5k molecules, 100 seeds) we evaluate two fusion topologies, each against its own graph-only control. In both, adding the text and descriptor experts contracts the seed-to-seed distribution of the threshold-free metrics—ROC-AUC σ falls five-fold in the flat topology and 1.6-fold in the hierarchical one, whose control was already the tighter of the two—and the collapse tail reaching ROC-AUC ≈ 0.45 that the weaker single-modality configurations carry is absent from the fused models while accuracy is retained. Each comparison is matched on everything but the fusion stage, isolating its effect. The router allocates a distinct mixture to each coordinate, which no scalar gate can represent, and the entropy weight moves that allocation continuously between graded mixing and a near-binary regime in which each coordinate is claimed outright by one modality. Fused-representation alignment tracks encoder quality without supervision, shifting from text to topology once pretraining lifts the graph embedding out of rank-1 collapse. The same three experts map onto crystal graphs, composition–structure descriptors and literature-mined text. These three modalities recur unchanged across molecular and inorganic chemistry, so TAME is a single interpretable recipe for turning volatile low-data predictors into reliable, self-explaining ones, wherever data are scarce and every failed prediction costs a real experiment.
items.summary_zh: TAME 以逐隐藏坐标的 Mixture-of-Experts 路由融合描述符、图和文本三种分子/材料表示，并在 scaffold-split BACE 的 100 个随机种子实验中降低性能波动和训练崩溃尾部。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工作把低数据学习的可靠性而非仅平均指标作为目标，且提出可解释的细粒度模态融合；不过主要实证集中于 BACE，向晶体和无机体系的迁移仍是作者提出的映射而非已展示的结果。
items.abstract_zh: 分子和材料的性质预测受标签稀缺制约；在这种情形下，实际的失败模式不是均值偏低，而是不可预测的尾部：个别训练运行会崩溃。三种主要分子表示以互补方式失败——物理化学描述符精确但固定，图神经网络学习拓扑但在稀疏监督下退化，语言模型提供语义上下文但无法计算精确量——然而，将它们组合本身就是学习问题，因为模态级标量门控会让整个模型对每个来源只承诺一个信任权重。我们引入 TAME：一种三模态编码器，其逐元素 Mixture-of-Experts 路由器为每个隐藏坐标分配独立的模态混合，并通过平衡–熵正则化、旨在消除路由器预热期的闭式门初始化（β = log τ）以及两阶段自监督图预训练来稳定。在 scaffold-split BACE（约 1.5k 个分子，100 个随机种子）上，我们评估两种融合拓扑，各自与其仅图模型对照比较。在两种拓扑中，加入文本和描述符专家都会收缩无阈值指标的种子间分布——平面拓扑中 ROC-AUC σ 下降五倍，分层拓扑中下降 1.6 倍，而后者的对照本已是较紧的一种——并且在较弱单模态配置中达到 ROC-AUC ≈ 0.45 的崩溃尾部在融合模型中消失，同时保持准确率。每项比较除融合阶段外均完全匹配，从而隔离其效应。路由器为每个坐标分配不同混合，这是任何标量门都无法表示的；熵权重使该分配在分级混合与近似二元状态之间连续变化，在后二元状态中每个坐标被某一模态完全占有。融合表示对齐在无监督条件下追踪编码器质量；一旦预训练使图嵌入摆脱 rank-1 崩溃，它便从文本转向拓扑。这三类专家可同样映射到晶体图、组成–结构描述符和文献挖掘文本。这三种模态在分子和无机化学中不变地重复出现，因此 TAME 是一种单一、可解释的方案，用于在数据稀缺、且每次失败预测都会付出真实实验代价的场景下，将不稳定的低数据预测器转变为可靠且可自解释的预测器。

items.title: Learning Universal Representations of Intermolecular Interactions with ATOMICA
items.abstract_or_text: Molecular interactions underlie nearly all biological processes, yet most representation models describe isolated entities or specialize in a single molecular setting. Here, we introduce ATOMICA, an interaction-centered geometric deep learning model designed to learn transferable representations of intermolecular interfaces across proteins, small molecules, metal ions, and nucleic acids. Self-supervised pretraining on 2,037,972 interaction complexes yields representations spanning atoms, molecular building blocks, and complete interfaces. The latent space captures molecular identity and interaction context, supporting sequence recovery and zero-shot prioritization of residues involved in non-covalent interactions. ATOMICA provides structural information complementary to sequence representations on RNA and protein-pocket ligand classification. Across protein-pocket analyses, ATOMICA distinguishes ATP- and ADP-associated pocket states and retrieves ligand-matched pockets across proteins without detectable structural alignment. The latent space also enables cross-modal comparison, with orthosteric inhibitor embeddings retrieving regions proximal to native peptide and protein interfaces. Applied to the dark proteome, ATOMICA-Ligand predicts candidate ions or cofactors for 2,646 pockets, and five heme candidates show Soret-band shifts consistent with heme association. Together, these results show how interaction-centered molecular representations can transfer structural information across molecular interaction types and generate experimentally testable hypotheses.
items.summary_zh: ATOMICA 是以分子间界面为中心的几何深度学习模型，在 2,037,972 个相互作用复合物上自监督预训练，并在暗蛋白组提出 2,646 个口袋的离子或辅因子候选；其中 5 个 heme 候选获光谱支持。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它尝试用统一表征跨越蛋白、小分子、金属离子和核酸相互作用，并将计算假设连接到 heme 结合实验；但多数下游结论仍为表示学习评估或预测，生物功能和其他预测需进一步验证。
items.abstract_zh: 分子相互作用支撑几乎所有生物过程，但大多数表征模型描述孤立实体，或专门针对单一分子环境。这里，我们引入 ATOMICA：一种以相互作用为中心的几何深度学习模型，旨在学习跨蛋白质、小分子、金属离子和核酸的可迁移分子间界面表征。在 2,037,972 个相互作用复合物上进行自监督预训练，得到涵盖原子、分子构件和完整界面的表征。该潜在空间捕捉分子身份和相互作用上下文，支持序列恢复以及对参与非共价相互作用的残基进行零样本优先排序。ATOMICA 在 RNA 和蛋白口袋–配体分类上提供了与序列表征互补的结构信息。在蛋白口袋分析中，ATOMICA 区分 ATP- 和 ADP- 相关的口袋状态，并在无需可检测结构比对的情况下跨蛋白检索配体匹配的口袋。该潜在空间还支持跨模态比较，正构抑制剂嵌入可检索接近天然肽和蛋白界面的区域。应用于暗蛋白组时，ATOMICA-Ligand 为 2,646 个口袋预测候选离子或辅因子，5 个 heme 候选显示出与 heme 结合一致的 Soret-band 位移。综上，这些结果表明，以相互作用为中心的分子表征可以在不同分子相互作用类型间迁移结构信息，并产生可实验检验的假设。
items.author_line: Fang, A., Desgagne, M., Zhang, Z., Zhou, A., Loscalzo, J., Pentelute, B. L., Zitnik, M.

items.title: Learning from tandem mass spectra at scale with a self-supervised foundation model for proteomics
items.abstract_or_text: Mass spectrometry-based proteomics increasingly relies on machine learning, yet existing models are trained for defined supervised tasks such as peptide identification, de novo sequencing or fragment intensity prediction, limiting transfer across datasets, instruments and acquisition methods. Here we present InstaNovo-FM, a self-supervised foundation model for bottom-up proteomics trained to reconstruct masked regions of tandem mass spectra. We assemble a diverse training corpus spanning 1.47 billion MS/MS spectra and 184.6 million high-confidence annotations. We train an encoder-only transformer on the annotated tier using a physics-aware masked reconstruction objective. We demonstrate that the InstaNovo-FM embeddings encode fundamental experimental and biological properties, including fragmentation method, sequence properties and post-translational modifications, without requiring peptide labels. Furthermore, this foundation model directly enables diverse downstream applications, including de novo peptide sequencing, database-free identification and analytical run classification. InstaNovo-FM establishes a unified representation space for peptide fragmentation spectra, enabling robust transferability across the proteomics ecosystem.
items.summary_zh: InstaNovo-FM 是面向 bottom-up proteomics 的自监督 foundation model，在 1.47 billion MS/MS 光谱和 184.6 million 高置信度注释上以物理感知掩码重建训练，可迁移至测序、无数据库鉴定和运行分类。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 大规模且跨实验条件的预训练有望减轻蛋白质组模型对特定仪器和监督任务的依赖；但摘要没有给出与专用模型的定量比较或外部前瞻验证，实际增益仍须核查。
items.abstract_zh: 基于质谱的蛋白质组学日益依赖机器学习，但现有模型是为肽段鉴定、从头测序或碎片离子强度预测等确定的监督任务训练的，这限制了其跨数据集、仪器和采集方法的迁移。这里，我们提出 InstaNovo-FM：一种面向 bottom-up proteomics 的自监督 foundation model，其训练目标是重建串联质谱中被掩蔽的区域。我们汇集了一个多样化训练语料库，涵盖 1.47 billion 个 MS/MS 光谱和 184.6 million 个高置信度注释。我们在注释层级上使用物理感知的掩码重建目标训练了一个仅编码器 transformer。我们证明，InstaNovo-FM 嵌入无需肽段标签即可编码基础实验和生物学性质，包括碎裂方法、序列性质和翻译后修饰。此外，这一 foundation model 可直接支持多种下游应用，包括从头肽段测序、无数据库鉴定和分析运行分类。InstaNovo-FM 为肽段碎裂光谱建立了统一的表征空间，使其可在整个蛋白质组学生态系统中实现稳健迁移。

items.title: Electrostatic Encoding Enables Simultaneous Dual Labeling of Proteins by a Single Sortase A Enzyme
items.abstract_or_text: Site-specific dual labeling of proteins provides access to multifunctional biomolecular constructs for applications ranging from imaging to the development of next-generation therapeutics. Currently, enzymatic dual labeling strategies rely on workflows involving multiple (semi-)orthogonal enzymes or temporary protection/deprotection schemes. Here, we present a one-pot strategy for protein dual labeling that relies on the single sortase A pentamutant (SrtA-5M) enzyme. By rationally designing complementary charged modules on the protein substrate and labeling reagent, we exploit electrostatic interactions to selectively guide the simultaneous installation of two distinct labels at the N- and C-termini of recombinant proteins without the need for multiple ligases, protecting groups, intermediate purification steps, or large reagent excesses. The efficiency of the approach is demonstrated on protein substrates and affords dually labeled products with high selectivity under mild reaction conditions. Beyond its practical utility, this study provides new insights into the influence of the P2 residue x within the sortase recognition motif (LPxTG) relative to glycyl nucleophiles, revealing an important role in governing sortase-mediated transpeptidation outcomes.
items.summary_zh: 该研究通过在蛋白底物和标记试剂上设计互补电荷模块，用单一 sortase A pentamutant (SrtA-5M) 在温和的一锅条件下同时完成重组蛋白 N、C 端双标记。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它以电静力编码减少多酶、保护/脱保护和中间纯化步骤，可简化多功能蛋白构建；但摘要所述验证限于蛋白底物，复杂蛋白、不同标签与规模化制备中的通用性仍未知。
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白质的位点特异性双标记可获得多功能生物分子构建体，应用范围从成像到开发下一代治疗药物。目前，酶促双标记策略依赖于涉及多个（半）正交酶的工作流，或临时保护/脱保护方案。这里，我们提出一种一锅式蛋白双标记策略，依赖于单一 sortase A pentamutant (SrtA-5M) 酶。通过在蛋白底物和标记试剂上理性设计互补带电模块，我们利用静电相互作用来选择性引导两种不同标签同时安装至重组蛋白的 N-端和 C-端，无需多个 ligases、保护基、中间纯化步骤或大量试剂过量。该方法的效率在蛋白底物上得到展示，并在温和反应条件下以高选择性获得双标记产物。除其实用价值外，本研究还为 sortase 识别基序 (LPxTG) 中 P2 残基 x 相对于 glycyl nucleophiles 的影响提供了新见解，揭示其在决定 sortase 介导转肽结果中具有重要作用。
items.author_line: Chen Wang, Magalie Sénéchal, Benoît Snella, Oleg Melnyk, Vangelis Agouridas

items.title: Near-Complete Synthon Library via Retrosynthetic Analysis for Automated Organic Synthesis
items.abstract_or_text: As idealized structural fragments for guiding bond disconnections, synthons are considered the conceptual backbone of retrosynthetic analysis. Yet retrosynthesis can be difficult because the choice of synthons requires extensive experience in organic synthesis, which prevents non-experts from accessing desired products. Here we address this knowledge gap by constructing a curated, machine interpretable database of commercially available synthon equivalents (hereafter valid synthons) distilled from large-scale retrosynthetic analysis. Mining over 40 million molecules from PubChem, we identify 1,617 essential valid synthons. These synthons, organized into (i) molecular backbones, (ii) functional groups, and (iii) linker motifs, were obtained via iterative retrosynthetic decomposition and stringent frequency based filtering tied to documented reaction precedents. The resulting set enables the in silico reconstruction of over 94% of these 40 million molecules. We demonstrate that such synthons reduce dependence on expansive reagent inventories, even though the routes themselves are non-conventional and algorithm-generated: using only seven representative valid synthons, we accessed three structurally and functionally divergent targets (melatonin, a natural sleep hormone; an azo dye; and a photoactive melatonin derivative), illustrating the breadth and practicality of a synthons to products methodology in the context of automated synthesis for non-experts in organic synthesis.
items.summary_zh: 研究从 PubChem 的 40 million 分子进行大规模逆合成挖掘，整理出 1,617 个可机器解释的 commercial valid synthons；该集合可在计算中重建超过 94% 的分子，并用 7 个 synthon 展示 3 个目标的可达性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 若能用紧凑且有反应先例约束的 synthon 集指导自动合成，可降低非专家对庞大试剂库和经验的依赖；但“重建”是计算路线层面的证据，尚未证明该库对广泛真实底物的自动化成功率。
items.abstract_zh: 作为指导键断裂的理想化结构片段，synthons 被视为逆合成分析的概念骨架。然而，逆合成可能很困难，因为 synthon 的选择需要丰富的有机合成经验，这使非专家难以获得期望产物。这里，我们通过构建一个经整理、机器可解释的商业可得 synthon 等价物数据库（下称 valid synthons）来解决这一知识缺口；该数据库源自大规模逆合成分析。通过挖掘 PubChem 中超过 40 million 个分子，我们识别出 1,617 个关键 valid synthons。这些 synthons 被组织为 (i) 分子骨架、(ii) 官能团和 (iii) 连接体基序，通过迭代逆合成分解和与已记录反应先例相关联的严格频率过滤得到。所得集合能够在计算中重建这 40 million 个分子中的超过 94%。我们证明，这些 synthons 可减少对庞大试剂库存的依赖，尽管路线本身是非传统且由算法生成的：仅使用 7 个代表性 valid synthons，我们就获得了 3 个在结构和功能上差异很大的目标物（褪黑素，一种天然睡眠激素；一种偶氮染料；以及一种光活性褪黑素衍生物），说明了面向有机合成非专家、在自动化合成背景下 synthons-to-products 方法学的广度和实用性。

items.title: De Novo Design and AlphaFold3 Evaluation of Protein Binders Targeting Specific Sites of MAP4K4
items.abstract_or_text: MAP4K4 is a serine/threonine kinase member of the mitogen activated protein kinase family. It acts through the JNK, p38 MAPK, and ERK1/2 pathways and is implicated in cancer proliferation and invasion, TNF--driven insulin resistance, macrophage-mediated inflammation, and cardiomyocyte apoptosis in heart failure. No selective small-molecule inhibitor of MAP4K4 has reached clinical use, and knowledge of the specific epitopes on MAP4K4 is lacking for some existing antibodies, leaving a role for small protein binders directed at specific surface sites. We used a computational pipeline that combines RFdiffusion, ProteinMPNN, and AlphaFold2, as well as BindCraft, an integrated "one-shot" tool, for de novo design of small protein binders (~50-130 residues) to specific MAP4K4 surface hotspots. We also created an automated hotspot determination algorithm that weighs geometry, chemistry, rigidity, and AlphaFold pLDDT. From thousands of candidate sequences, we evaluated 20 of the most promising binders with AlphaFold3 (AF3). The interface predicted template modeling (ipTM) scores ranged from 0.16 to 0.90, with nine candidates having ipTM [≥] 0.80, and five scoring [≥] 0.87. Two binders engage non-overlapping hotspots on opposite faces of MAP4K4, making them a candidate pair for a sandwich assay. BLASTp searches of all designed protein sequences returned only low-significance matches to half of them, indicating that they represent truly novel binding solutions and previously unexplored regions of protein sequence space rather than rediscovered natural motifs. We subjected five complexes spanning the observed AF3 confidence range to 100-ns explicit-solvent molecular dynamics simulation. Interchain contacts were retained throughout, with stability varying substantially between systems. Confidence in the binding specificity of the nine highest-confidence candidates was bolstered by juxtaposition with AF3 evaluations of their interaction with CDK2, a negative-control kinase. This comparison yielded a significant, consistent reduction in ipTM (p = 0.0039) for the control binding partner. ToxinPred2 and AlgPred 2.0 screening suggested that one candidate was a potential allergen and two were potential toxins. These results support that de novo design of small, site-specific protein probes for an underserved disease target is achievable using free, publicly available computational tools and minimal resources, pointing to a greater role for the public and amateur scientists to contribute to biotechnological advancement.
items.summary_zh: 研究以 RFdiffusion、ProteinMPNN、AlphaFold2、BindCraft 和自动热点筛选设计 MAP4K4 特定位点的小型蛋白 binder；AF3、100-ns MD 和 CDK2 负对照支持部分候选的计算结合特异性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作展示了低资源、开放工具链对疾病相关激酶表位设计的可行性，并提出可用于 sandwich assay 的成对候选物；但所有结合、选择性和安全性结论仍为计算预测，尚无体外或体内实验证实。
items.abstract_zh: MAP4K4 是 mitogen activated protein kinase 家族中的一种 serine/threonine kinase 成员。它通过 JNK、p38 MAPK 和 ERK1/2 通路发挥作用，并涉及癌症增殖和侵袭、TNF--驱动的胰岛素抵抗、巨噬细胞介导的炎症以及心力衰竭中的心肌细胞凋亡。尚无选择性 MAP4K4 小分子抑制剂进入临床使用，而一些现有抗体针对 MAP4K4 的特异表位尚不清楚，因此存在开发针对特定表面位点的小型蛋白 binder 的需求。我们使用一条计算流程，结合 RFdiffusion、ProteinMPNN 和 AlphaFold2，以及集成式“one-shot”工具 BindCraft，为 MAP4K4 特异表面热点从头设计小型蛋白 binder（约 50-130 个残基）。我们还创建了一种自动热点确定算法，综合权衡几何、化学、刚性和 AlphaFold pLDDT。在数千条候选序列中，我们用 AlphaFold3 (AF3) 评估了 20 个最有希望的 binders。界面预测模板建模 (ipTM) 分数范围为 0.16 至 0.90，其中 9 个候选物的 ipTM [≥] 0.80，5 个达到 [≥] 0.87。两个 binders 结合 MAP4K4 相对两面的不重叠热点，使它们成为 sandwich assay 的候选配对。对所有设计蛋白序列进行的 BLASTp 搜索仅在其中一半序列中返回低显著性匹配，表明它们代表真正新颖的结合方案和此前未探索的蛋白序列空间区域，而非重新发现的天然基序。我们对覆盖所观察 AF3 置信度范围的 5 个复合物进行了 100-ns 显式溶剂分子动力学模拟。链间接触在整个过程中得到保留，但不同体系间稳定性差异很大。通过将这 9 个最高置信度候选物与其同 CDK2（负对照 kinase）的 AF3 相互作用评估并置，进一步增强了对其结合特异性的信心。该比较显示，对照结合伙伴的 ipTM 显著且一致降低（p = 0.0039）。ToxinPred2 和 AlgPred 2.0 筛查表明，1 个候选物可能是 allergen，2 个可能是 toxins。这些结果支持：使用免费、公开可得的计算工具和最少资源，实现针对一个未被充分服务的疾病靶点、从头设计小型位点特异性蛋白 probes 是可行的；这也指向公众和业余科学家在生物技术进步中做出更多贡献的更大作用。

items.title: Chromosomal mutational signatures of DNA damaging agents at single cell resolution
items.abstract_or_text: The chromosomal-scale mutational spectrum of small molecules that interact with DNA has been hard to study at scale, as mutational events are distributed in location and occur in parallel in different cells. Here, we present a framework that pairs phylogenetic ancestry reconstruction with mutational signature decomposition to characterise recent, cell-private copy number alteration (CNA) mutational patterns at single-cell resolution. We used this framework to characterise the cell-wise mutational spectrum of contemporaneous CNAs generated by double-strand-break-inducing chemotherapeutic drugs. We demonstrate that platinum salts, G-quadruplex stabilizers and topoisomerase II inhibitors, although mechanistically distinct, converge on a mutational signature dominated by telomere-bounded copy-number gains and losses. This signature is observed in different genetic backgrounds and in vivo in drug-treated patient-derived xenografts. We also observe a high rate of endogenous telomere-bounded mutational foreground in BRCA1 deficient cells. We show that the single cell genome derived signature exposures are drug dose-dependent, and use this to identify the decay of mutational load after drug withdrawal. We observe that both cisplatin and a G4 binder molecule (CX5461) exhibit foreground mutational signature persistence for at least 3 weeks after drug withdrawal, suggesting that residual effects of exposure may last longer than anticipated. Finally, extending the framework to serially drug-treated patient-derived xenograft (PDX) models, we show that telomere-bounded CNA signature exposure is associated with tumoural response to drug, consistent with loss of mutational activity on the genome after acquired resistance emerges. Together, our results show that our framework applied on scWGS identifies contemporaneous chromosomal mutation patterns induced by small molecules in human tissues.
items.summary_zh: 该研究以单细胞全基因组测序、系统发育重建和突变特征分解，解析DNA损伤药物诱导的染色体拷贝数改变；在遗传背景、剂量、停药时间及患者来源异种移植模型间检验了特征。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把药物暴露的染色体突变负担量化到单细胞层面，并在PDX中关联治疗反应，为研究基因组毒性与耐药过程提供了可检验的分析框架。
items.abstract_zh: 与DNA相互作用的小分子的染色体尺度突变谱一直难以大规模研究，因为突变事件在位置上分散，并且在不同细胞中并行发生。我们在此提出一个框架，将系统发育祖先重建与突变特征分解配对，以在单细胞分辨率下表征近期、细胞私有的拷贝数改变（CNA）突变模式。我们使用该框架表征由诱导双链断裂的化疗药物产生的同时期CNA的逐细胞突变谱。我们证明，铂盐、G-四链体稳定剂和拓扑异构酶II抑制剂尽管机制不同，却汇聚到一种以端粒为边界的拷贝数增加和缺失为主导的突变特征。该特征可在不同遗传背景中观察到，并在经药物治疗的患者来源异种移植模型中于体内观察到。我们还观察到BRCA1缺陷细胞中以端粒为边界的内源性突变前景具有很高发生率。我们显示，单细胞基因组衍生的特征暴露量与药物剂量相关，并利用这一点识别停药后突变负担的衰减。我们观察到，顺铂和一种G4结合分子（CX5461）的前景突变特征在停药后至少3周仍持续存在，提示暴露的残余效应可能比预期持续更久。最后，将该框架扩展到连续药物治疗的患者来源异种移植（PDX）模型时，我们发现端粒为边界的CNA特征暴露与肿瘤对药物的反应有关，这与获得性耐药出现后基因组突变活动丧失相一致。总之，我们的结果显示，将该框架应用于scWGS可识别人类组织中由小分子诱导的同时期染色体突变模式。

items.title: Predicting Endometriosis Status and Menstrual Cycle Phase Using DNA Methylation
items.abstract_or_text: Endometriosis is a chronic inflammatory disease associated with pelvic pain, infertility, and delayed diagnosis. Growing evidence suggests that altered DNA methylation contributes to disease development and could serve as a biomarker for disease. We developed a leakage-safe machine learning pipeline to classify endometriosis case-control status and menstrual cycle phase using genome-wide DNA methylation data from eutopic endometrial tissue. The dataset consisted of 984 samples profiled using the Illumina Infinium MethylationEPIC array, with measurements across approximately 759,000 CpG sites. Technical variation was corrected using SmartSVA batch correction. Ridge logistic regression models were trained using stratified 80/20 train-test splits, with regularization strength selected via stratified cross-validation. Feature selection approaches included ridge coefficient ranking, per-CpG t-tests, and univariate logistic regression with FDR correction. Model validity was evaluated using label-shuffling analyses. Menstrual cycle phase classification showed strong performance (mean cross-validation AUROC: 0.971, held-out test AUROC: 0.989), reflecting genome-wide hormonally driven methylation. Ridge regression produced lower but meaningful performance for endometriosis classification (mean cross-validation AUROC: 0.854, held-out test AUROC: 0.875). Ridge coefficient-based feature selection identified compact predictive CpG sets, supporting the hypothesis that endometriosis-associated methylation signal is distributed across many loci rather than a few highly predictive CpGs. Pathway enrichment analyses identified substantial enrichment for menstrual cycle phase but limited enrichment for disease status following FDR correction, consistent with a diffuse endometriosis-associated signal. These findings demonstrate that ridge regression can detect methylation patterns associated with both endometriosis and menstrual cycle phase, highlighting the importance of accounting for cycle-related epigenetic variation in endometrial DNA methylation studies.
items.summary_zh: 研究在984份子宫内膜组织的约75.9万个CpG位点上，以防泄漏流程构建子宫内膜异位症和月经周期分期模型；异位症的留出测试AUROC为0.875。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它量化了月经周期相关甲基化变异这一关键混杂因素，并用标签置换检验模型有效性；该结果是组织关联和分类性能，尚非可临床使用的诊断测试。
items.abstract_zh: 子宫内膜异位症是一种与盆腔疼痛、不孕和延迟诊断相关的慢性炎症性疾病。越来越多的证据提示，DNA甲基化改变有助于疾病发展，并可能作为疾病生物标志物。我们开发了一条防止泄漏的机器学习流程，利用来自在位子宫内膜组织的全基因组DNA甲基化数据，对子宫内膜异位症病例—对照状态和月经周期阶段进行分类。该数据集由984份使用Illumina Infinium MethylationEPIC芯片分析的样本构成，覆盖约759,000个CpG位点。技术变异使用SmartSVA批次校正进行纠正。岭逻辑回归模型使用分层80/20训练—测试划分训练，并通过分层交叉验证选择正则化强度。特征选择方法包括岭回归系数排序、逐CpG t检验以及带FDR校正的单变量逻辑回归。通过标签打乱分析评估模型有效性。月经周期阶段分类表现强劲（平均交叉验证AUROC：0.971；留出测试AUROC：0.989），反映了全基因组激素驱动的甲基化。岭回归在子宫内膜异位症分类中表现较低但有意义（平均交叉验证AUROC：0.854；留出测试AUROC：0.875）。基于岭系数的特征选择识别出紧凑的预测CpG集合，支持这样一种假设：子宫内膜异位症相关甲基化信号分布于许多位点，而非少数高度预测性的CpG。通路富集分析显示月经周期阶段显著富集，而FDR校正后疾病状态的富集有限，这与弥散的子宫内膜异位症相关信号一致。这些发现表明，岭回归可检测与子宫内膜异位症和月经周期阶段均相关的甲基化模式，并突出了在子宫内膜DNA甲基化研究中考虑周期相关表观遗传变异的重要性。

items.title: A dual proteomics analysis of paired cerebrospinal fluid and plasma from patients with neurodegenerative diseases
items.abstract_or_text: INTRODUCTION: Understanding concordance across biofluids and platforms is critical for understanding neurodegenerative biomarkers results and translating them into clinical use; yet systematic comparisons remain limited. To address this gap, we performed large-scale proteomic profiling of patient-paired plasma and CSF to characterize cross-modal relationships. METHODS: We profiled paired plasma and CSF from 67 individuals using SomaScan 11K and NULISAseq CNS panels. Disease severity was assessed with the CDR+NACC FTLD-M Global Score. RESULTS: We identified 269 SomaScan and 18 NULISA proteins with significant cross-biofluid correlation. Cross-platform concordance within biofluids was strong. NEFL, NPTX2, TREM2, and CHIT1 demonstrated consistent cross-platform agreement. Associations with disease severity were compartment-specific, with decreased NPTX2 in CSF, increased NEFL and GFAP in plasma, and decreased TREM2 across biofluids. DISCUSSION: Cross-platform consistency supports biomarker robustness, while limited cross-biofluid concordance highlights compartmental biology. Given additional clinical correlations despite varying underlying pathology, these findings may point to shared neurodegenerative disorder pathways.
items.summary_zh: 该配对脑脊液—血浆蛋白质组研究在67名个体中比较SomaScan 11K与NULISAseq CNS，并报告NEFL、NPTX2、TREM2和CHIT1的跨平台一致性及与疾病严重度的区室特异关联。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 配对体液与跨平台的比较有助于厘清神经退行性疾病生物标志物的稳健性和区室差异，但样本规模有限，关联结果不等同于共同病理机制。
items.abstract_zh: 引言：理解不同生物流体和平台之间的一致性，对于理解神经退行性疾病生物标志物结果并将其转化用于临床至关重要；但系统比较仍然有限。为弥补这一缺口，我们对患者配对的血浆和脑脊液进行了大规模蛋白质组分析，以表征跨模态关系。方法：我们使用SomaScan 11K和NULISAseq CNS面板，对67名个体的配对血浆和脑脊液进行分析。疾病严重程度采用CDR+NACC FTLD-M Global Score评估。结果：我们识别出269种SomaScan蛋白和18种NULISA蛋白具有显著的跨体液相关性。体液内的跨平台一致性很强。NEFL、NPTX2、TREM2和CHIT1表现出一致的跨平台一致性。与疾病严重程度的关联具有区室特异性：CSF中的NPTX2降低，血浆中的NEFL和GFAP增加，而TREM2在两种体液中均降低。讨论：跨平台一致性支持生物标志物的稳健性，而有限的跨体液一致性突出了区室生物学。鉴于尽管基础病理不同仍存在额外的临床相关性，这些发现可能指向神经退行性疾病的共同通路。

items.title: Trustworthy ML/AI for Aging Clocks: Preventing Systematic Prediction Bias in Biological Age Estimation
items.abstract_or_text: Machine learning (ML)- and artificial intelligence (AI)-based aging clocks are increasingly used to quantify physiological and molecular aging from omics and medical imaging data as distinct from chronological age. Here, we characterize a fundamental but underappreciated statistical limitation of commonly used ML/AI regression models for continuous outcomes: systematic prediction bias and its propagation to downstream association estimates. This issue becomes more challenging when the true outcome, biological age, is latent and therefore unobserved during ML/AI model training. We demonstrate that systematic prediction bias can distort and, in some cases, even reverse downstream association analyses that use aging clocks as ML/AI-predicted outcomes to assess their associations with exposures or clinical factors. For example, it can produce spurious associations suggesting that older predicted brain age is linked to better cognitive performance, or that older epigenetic age is associated with better kidney function. To address this problem, we introduce a principled and broadly applicable ML/AI regression framework based on constrained optimization, yielding better calibrated aging-clock estimates and valid downstream inference.
items.summary_zh: 研究指出常用连续结局ML/AI回归中的系统性预测偏差可扭曲衰老时钟的下游关联，甚至造成方向相反的虚假关联，并提出以约束优化改善校准和推断的框架。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它直接针对生物年龄作为不可观测真值时的统计识别问题，提醒衰老时钟研究不能将模型输出与暴露或临床因素的关联直接解释为生物学关系。
items.abstract_zh: 基于机器学习（ML）和人工智能（AI）的衰老时钟日益用于从组学和医学影像数据中量化区别于时间年龄的生理和分子衰老。我们在此刻画了常用连续结局ML/AI回归模型中一个基础但被忽视的统计学局限：系统性预测偏差及其向下游关联估计的传播。当真实结局即生物年龄是潜变量、因而在ML/AI模型训练期间不可观测时，这一问题更具挑战。我们证明，系统性预测偏差能够扭曲、并在某些情况下甚至反转使用衰老时钟这一ML/AI预测结局来评估其与暴露或临床因素关联的下游关联分析。例如，它可以产生虚假关联，提示预测脑龄较高与较好的认知表现相关，或预测表观遗传年龄较高与较好的肾功能相关。为解决这一问题，我们引入一种基于约束优化的、有原则且广泛适用的ML/AI回归框架，可产生校准更好的衰老时钟估计和有效的下游推断。

items.title: Transcriptome profiling identifies the chromatoid body as a dynamic center for RNA surveillance and transcript sorting during spermatogenesis
items.abstract_or_text: The chromatoid body (CB) is a hallmark of haploid male germ cells, but how it selects and regulates RNAs has remained unclear. Here we define the RNA landscape of the CB by transcriptome and small RNA profiling of isolated CBs throughout mouse round spermatid differentiation. We find that the CB selectively concentrates pachytene piRNAs, retrotransposon transcripts, specific mRNA isoforms and intron-retaining mRNAs, revealing extensive RNA sorting within this cytoplasmic germline condensate. The enrichment of transposable element transcripts together with PIWI-piRNA complexes identifies the CB as a surveillance center that may safeguard genome integrity in post-meiotic haploid cells. Unexpectedly, mRNA recruitment is not determined by predicted piRNA targeting. Instead, transcript localization is encoded by a combinatorial set of intrinsic sequence and structural features that accurately predict CB enrichment at isoform resolution. These findings establish the CB as a dynamic post-transcriptional regulatory compartment that integrates genome surveillance, RNA quality control and selective transcript sorting, uncovering general principles through which biomolecular condensates shape cell-specific transcriptomes.

items.title: Pneumonia Detection in Paediatric Chest X-Rays using Ensembled Large Language Models
items.abstract_or_text: Background: Paediatric pneumonia is a major cause of childhood morbidity and mortality. Chest X-rays (CXR) are central to diagnosis, but shortages of specialist radiologists can delay reporting. Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) may assist clinical workflows by analysing images and communicating findings, but few open-source MLLMs are specifically pre-trained on paediatric CXRs. Objective: To evaluate whether ensemble strategies improve MLLM diagnostic performance for paediatric radiological pneumonia detection on CXRs without any fine-tuning, and to assess the generalisability of ensemble findings across datasets. Methods: In this retrospective study, paediatric CXRs from three datasets were analysed. Two internal datasets (balanced and real-world) were acquired from KK Women's and Children's Hospital (KKH), Singapore, where images were independently reviewed by two board-certified radiologists with pneumonia severity assigned to three classes using a predefined consensus algorithm. A third external dataset, the publicly available Kermany CXR Pneumonia dataset, was included to evaluate generalisability. Fifteen MedGemma-4B-it agents classified each CXR, with majority voting, soft voting, and GPTOSS-20B aggregation compared against baseline average agent performance. The primary outcome was One-vs-Rest (OvR) AUROC. Results: The KKH balanced dataset contained 1,000 CXRs and the real-world dataset contained 1,300 CXRs. The Kermany external validation dataset contained 5,856 CXRs. Soft voting significantly improved OvR-AUROC over baseline in all three datasets: balanced dataset improved by +0.065 (95% Confidence Interval (CI) = [+0.051, +0.078], P = 0.0001), real-world dataset improved by +0.073 (95% CI = [+0.051, +0.091], P = 0.0003), and Kermany dataset improved by +0.103 (95% CI = [+0.087, +0.119], P = 0.0001). In the KKH datasets, soft voting also improved accuracy, Cohen's {kappa}, and One-vs-One (OvO) AUROC, and improved F1-score in the balanced dataset. GPTOSS-20B and majority voting demonstrated significantly superior specificity across all datasets. Conclusion: Soft voting ensembles consistently enhance MedGemma's diagnostic discriminatory performance for paediatric radiological pneumonia detection across both internal and external validation datasets. This ensemble framework enables privacy-preserving, near real-time clinical decision support with explainable outputs, with potential for integration into paediatric emergency workflows pending prospective validation. The system's high specificity supports a triage role in flagging high-risk radiological pneumonia cases for urgent clinician review.

items.abstract_zh: 背景：儿童肺炎是儿童发病和死亡的重要原因。胸部X线片（CXR）是诊断的核心，但专科放射科医师短缺可能延迟报告。多模态大语言模型（MLLM）可通过分析图像和传达发现来辅助临床工作流，但很少有开源MLLM专门在儿童CXR上进行预训练。目标：评估在不进行任何微调的情况下，集成策略是否能改善MLLM对儿童CXR放射学肺炎检测的诊断性能，并评估集成结果在不同数据集之间的可泛化性。方法：在这项回顾性研究中，分析了来自三个数据集的儿童CXR。两个内部数据集（平衡集和真实世界集）来自新加坡KK妇女儿童医院（KKH），图像由两名经认证的放射科医师独立阅片，并使用预先定义的共识算法将肺炎严重程度分为三类。第三个外部数据集是公开的Kermany CXR Pneumonia数据集，用于评估泛化性。15个MedGemma-4B-it智能体对每张CXR分类，并将多数投票、软投票和GPTOSS-20B聚合与基线平均智能体性能比较。主要结局是One-vs-Rest（OvR）AUROC。结果：KKH平衡数据集包含1,000张CXR，真实世界数据集包含1,300张CXR。Kermany外部验证数据集包含5,856张CXR。软投票在全部三个数据集中均显著提高OvR-AUROC：平衡数据集提高+0.065（95%置信区间（CI）=[+0.051，+0.078]，P=0.0001），真实世界数据集提高+0.073（95% CI=[+0.051，+0.091]，P=0.0003），Kermany数据集提高+0.103（95% CI=[+0.087，+0.119]，P=0.0001）。在KKH数据集中，软投票还改善了准确率、Cohen's κ和One-vs-One（OvO）AUROC，并在平衡数据集中改善F1评分。GPTOSS-20B和多数投票在所有数据集中表现出显著更高的特异性。结论：软投票集成在内部和外部验证数据集上均持续增强MedGemma对儿童放射学肺炎检测的诊断判别性能。该集成框架提供了具有可解释输出的、保护隐私的近实时临床决策支持，并有望在经前瞻性验证后整合进儿科急诊工作流。该系统的高特异性支持其在标记需紧急临床医师复核的高风险放射学肺炎病例中发挥分诊作用。

items.title: @OpenAI：How we think about the “wiki incident,” where our agents wrote to several internet sites: it’s past time for us to defin
items.abstract_or_text: How we think about the “wiki incident,” where our agents wrote to several internet sites: it’s past time for us to define standards for when and how we share misalignment incidents, not just misalignment properties of our models. Historically, we have treated misalignment largely as a research question, which gets communicated in research publications such as systems cards. This year, we’ve started to see misalignment cause new types of real-world impact. For the Hugging Face incident, where misalignment led to security impact to us and third parties, we followed a traditional security incident response playbook. We immediately started working with Hugging Face to understand what had happened and also disclosed publicly the very next day. Our investigation continues, and we are continuing to notify parties whom our models impacted in less significant ways. Prior to the Hugging Face incident, we saw early signs of agents using the internet in unintended ways, as reported in https://t.co/9aiRxk2eUJ, https://t.co/ADjyzwSUGz, and https://t.co/SUV6jZ3Gaz. We considered the wiki incident to be an instance of misalignment similar to the ones we’d shared. Our misalignment disclosure practices need to expand for this new phase of model capabilities. We and the larger AI community do not yet have a clear standard for how to report misalignment that shows up during training, evaluation, and deployment, including examples that don’t look like traditional security incidents but could provide insight into AI behavior and future risks. We’re working on a framework and will share it in upcoming weeks, and in parallel we're working with dozens of government regulatory agencies worldwide on these issues.
